description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions related to process file information, specifically testing UID and PID collection functionalities in the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: SelfUidTest
methods.description: Tests that the UID obtained from the process matches the UID reported by the system.

methods.name: CurrentPidCollected
methods.description: Tests that the current process ID is included in the list of PIDs owned by the current user.
